_readme: Input to `npm run art-prompts -- art/prompts/sheet-1-manifest.json 1`. Plan step 1.6, prompt sheet 1: 10 opponent portraits, the card back, 3 pub backgrounds, the app icon. Portrait/background art ids are prefixed to keep this UI-asset namespace separate from card artIds in src/cards/data (e.g. 'sherlock-holmes' is already a card-art id for his signature card — this sheet's 'portrait-sherlock-holmes' is a different asset, the tonight's-patrons roster portrait). Ordered so each family's Regular-tier portrait generates first and becomes that family's in-sheet reference for later rows (style-bible.md §7).

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom. Portrait of a young Metropolitan Police constable in his early twenties: round, earnest face, slightly flushed from hurrying, high-collared gunmetal-blue wool uniform with brass buttons, tall custodian helmet held under one arm rather than worn, a whistle chain visible at his chest. Eyebrows raised, slightly out of breath, caught mid-arrival rather than posed formally. Warm gaslight-amber key light from one side, cool gunmetal-blue ambient fill favouring the uniform, real cast shadows. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional Victorian book-plate lighting. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of a foggy London street corner.
rows.notes: design.md §9.1, 'always slightly out of breath.' First Yard portrait — becomes the in-sheet Yard reference for Inspector Bucket below.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom. Portrait of an elderly flower seller: weathered, knowing face, one eyebrow raised as if about to tell you half of something, worn shawl over a patched dress, a wicker basket of violets held at her chest. Standing in a doorway lit by a street gaslamp. Warm gaslight-amber key light, cool blue-grey ambient shadow fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of a foggy shopfront and lamp-post.
rows.notes: design.md §9.1, "Violets, guv? Or the other thing?" First Irregulars portrait — becomes the in-sheet Irregulars reference for Bucket, Adler, and Holmes below.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom. Portrait of a stocky middle-aged fence behind a pawnshop counter: oxblood-leather waistcoat over a rumpled shirt, sleeves rolled, a loupe pushed up onto his forehead, one hand resting protectively on a ledger. Defensive, faintly offended expression, chin lifted. Warm gaslight-amber key light, oxblood-leather tones dominant in wardrobe and counter, cool ambient fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of pawnshop shelving.
rows.notes: design.md §9.1, "Everything on this table's legitimate. Mostly." First Rookery portrait — becomes the in-sheet Rookery reference for Adler and Moriarty below.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom. Portrait of a young woman in a modest but sharply tailored verdigris-green Victorian dress, hair pinned severely back, a fountain pen tucked behind one ear, a faint knowing smile as if she's already solved something. Warm gaslight key light with cool verdigris-green ambient fill from drawing-room brocade behind her. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of a parlour bookshelf.
rows.notes: design.md §9.1, "I've already worked out how you did it. Sit down." First Salon portrait — becomes the in-sheet Salon reference for Dickens below.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom and Sir Charles's own portrait. Portrait of a Victorian countess in an elegant dress with brass-toned trim, seated near a mechanical difference-engine apparatus, calm analytical expression, one hand resting lightly on a brass lever. Warm brass-and-copper key light, cog-work and rivets rendered with real engineering logic in the soft background blur. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of workshop brass fittings.
extraNegatives: no exact photographic likeness, no caricature exaggeration — recognisable but lightly stylised
rows.notes: design.md §9.2, "Your deck has a loop in it. I can see it from here." First Foundry portrait; attaches the existing Sir Charles reference (both Foundry).

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom and the Yard constable's portrait. Portrait of a stout, patient plainclothes police inspector in a dark gunmetal-blue coat and waistcoat, one forefinger raised beside his temple as if about to make a point, calm knowing half-smile, sharp watchful eyes. Warm gaslight-amber accent light on one side of his face, cool gunmetal-blue dominant in coat and ambient fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of a study or informal parlour.
extraNegatives: no exact photographic likeness, no caricature exaggeration — recognisable but lightly stylised
rows.notes: design.md §9.2, "I'll just sit here, if I may, and think about you." Yard + Irregulars — Yard dominant per style-bible.md's one-dominant-family rule; attaches both the Yard (Mudd) and Irregulars (Ashby) in-sheet references.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom and the pawnbroker's and flower seller's portraits. Portrait of a striking, self-possessed Victorian woman in a fitted travelling coat trimmed in oxblood leather, faint knowing smile, direct confident gaze straight at the viewer. Warm gaslight-amber accent light, oxblood-leather tones dominant in wardrobe, cool ambient fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of a train platform or hansom-cab door.
extraNegatives: no exact photographic likeness, no caricature exaggeration — recognisable but lightly stylised
rows.notes: design.md §9.2, "Good night, Mr Sherlock Holmes." Rookery + Irregulars — Rookery dominant; attaches both the Rookery (Farrow) and Irregulars (Ashby) in-sheet references. The only portrait in this set looking straight at the viewer — she's the exception, style-bible.md §6.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom and Miss Hollis's portrait. Portrait of a Victorian gentleman with a full beard, animated and expressive mid-gesture as if reading aloud to a room, verdigris-green waistcoat, a walking stick implied at his side. Warm gaslight key light, cool verdigris-green ambient fill from drawing-room brocade. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of a lecture hall or parlour.
extraNegatives: no exact photographic likeness, no caricature exaggeration — recognisable but lightly stylised
rows.notes: design.md §9.2, "You'll have to wait for the ending. Everyone does." Attaches the in-sheet Salon (Hollis) reference.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom and the flower seller's portrait. Portrait of a tall, sharp-featured Victorian gentleman detective, high collar, no deerstalker or cape (accurate to period, not caricature), faintly bored and appraising expression, eyes doing all the work. Warm gaslight-amber key light, cool ambient fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of Baker Street clutter — papers, a chemistry rack.
extraNegatives: no exact photographic likeness, no caricature exaggeration — recognisable but lightly stylised
no deerstalker cap, no Inverness cape, no calabash pipe
rows.notes: design.md §9.3, "You've been to the Foundry. It's on your cuff." This is the tonight's-patrons roster portrait — distinct from the 'sherlock-holmes' card-art id used for his signature legendary card. Attaches the in-sheet Irregulars (Ashby) reference.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom and the pawnbroker's portrait. Portrait of a gaunt, high-domed Victorian academic in a dark coat trimmed in oxblood leather, hands loosely clasped, unnervingly still and precise expression. Warm gaslight-amber accent light on one side, oxblood-leather tones dominant, cool ambient fill. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows. Bust-to-shoulders portrait, background a soft blur of a study with a chalkboard of faint, barely-legible equations.
extraNegatives: no exact photographic likeness, no caricature exaggeration — recognisable but lightly stylised
no legible mathematics or writing on the chalkboard
rows.notes: design.md §9.3, "You stand fire admirably." Distinct from the 'professor-moriarty' card-art id used for his signature legendary card. Attaches the in-sheet Rookery (Farrow) reference.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, a card-back design for a Victorian pub card game. A single brass cog-and-gear emblem at the center, with a decorative diamond of four crossed brass struts worked into it — an abstracted nod to a Wheatstone bridge circuit — set on a deep ink-black ground within a parchment-cream border of engraved foliate scrollwork, a single hairline of sovereign gold tracing the emblem's edge. Symmetrical, medallion-like composition, engraved-seal aesthetic. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight catching the brass and gold.
extraNegatives: no monogram or initials, no playing-card suit symbols, no realistic scene or figures, no photographic metal reflections
rows.notes: design.md §1.1/§9.3 — the bridge-circuit motif nods to the real Wheatstone bridge (see Agatha Christie's flavour text). Shared back for every card in the deck; SVG frame (a later Phase-3 step) supplies the border, so keep this self-contained rather than frame-shaped.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom reference. A small, intimate snug room off the main taproom: a low fireplace with a single high-backed wing chair angled toward the flames, oxblood-leather upholstery, a low brass-fitted table, verdigris-green wallpaper faded at the edges, a scatter of foxed newspaper pages and a folded shawl on a side table. Warm amber firelight as the dominant source, cool blue-grey light seeping from a small window. Deep, lived-in detail — worn floorboards, a sleeping cat shape barely visible in shadow near the hearth. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight and firelight with real cast shadows.
rows.notes: design.md §14.6/§1.4 — the empty wing chair by the fire is the Landlady's, always empty until earned; keep it unoccupied and slightly apart from the room.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom reference. A quieter back parlour used for cards and conversation: a round brass-legged table set for a card game, mismatched chairs, gunmetal-blue window shutters closed against the evening fog, shelves of ledgers and bric-a-brac. A single hanging gaslamp casts a warm pool of amber light over the table while the corners fall into cool shadow. Deep, lived-in detail — worn card-table felt, a brass ashtray, a coat on a hook. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows.
rows.notes: Match room, per plan step 2.x's future match screen — composed with room to lay UI over the lower third (style-bible.md §4).

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, matching the palette and lighting of the Wheatstone Bridge taproom reference. The pub's stone cellar, where Sir Charles's Foundry machinery lives alongside the ale casks: brass pipework and a small difference-engine apparatus bolted to one wall beside ranked oak barrels, a narrow stone stairway climbing out of frame toward a warm light above, exposed brick and old iron braces. A single caged gaslamp near the machinery casts hard amber light against deep cool shadow elsewhere. Deep, lived-in detail — condensation beading on old pipes, chalk marks on a barrel. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, directional gaslight with real cast shadows.
rows.notes: design.md §1.2 — "one fault in time in the cellar." Legends "come up the cellar stairs" (§9.3); this is their entrance.

rows.prompt: Painterly digital illustration in a Victorian-engineering steampunk style, a bold, simple app-icon mark for a Victorian pub card game: a single ornate brass gear interlocked with an abstracted bridge-arch diamond silhouette (echoing a Wheatstone bridge circuit), rendered as one graphic emblem centered on a deep ink-black ground, sovereign-gold rim light tracing the gear teeth. Detail kept large and simple enough to read clearly at thumbnail size. Confident inked contours softened under paint, faint paper-grain texture, a single warm gaslight-amber key light from above. No scene — the emblem fills the frame edge to edge.
extraNegatives: no realistic scene or background detail
no fine detail or thin lines that would blur at small sizes
rows.notes: iOS/TestFlight app icon (Phase 4) and PWA icon (public/, Phase 0). Square, full-bleed — no rounded-corner mask baked in, iOS applies its own mask.
